name: Keltner volatility breakout
description: Buy a close above the Keltner channel when a trend is forming.

about.how_it_works: The Keltner channel sits two ATRs around a 20-bar EMA, so a close above it is a larger-than-usual move. Requiring ADX above 20 filters out random spikes in dead markets. It exits back at the channel's middle.
about.works_best: The start of volatile moves, like news-driven rallies.
about.fails_when: Spikes that immediately reverse. The ATR stop sizes risk to current volatility.
